ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (approx. 65:35). Large low-intensity central region (black) contrasted against high-intensity lateral regions (white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black pigmentation extends from the peduncle attachment to the mid-lobes in a wide V-shape. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized on the distal third of both lobes. A speckled, high-variance transition zone is visible at the pigment interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable irregular peaks and valleys, particularly a large jagged indentation on the distal half of the left lobe.
